notes: Table 25 (Algebra I) and Table 26 (Algebra II) are the authority for direct Texas-TEKS-to-Digital-SAT claims in this ledger.

Do not promote Grade 6, Grade 7, or Grade 8 prerequisite TEKS to direct SAT alignment merely because their mathematics appears in PSDA; the College Board Texas report aligns Grade 8 mathematics to PSAT 8/9 rather than SAT.

SAT-native PSDA constructs that lack a direct Algebra I/II TEKS row must be covered without misrepresenting prerequisite TEKS as an official SAT alignment. That architecture remains a release-blocking coverage item.
